final: SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.birth_date FROM client AS c JOIN disp AS p ON p.client_id = c.client_id JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN district AS branch_d ON branch_d.district_id = a.district_id WHERE c.birth_date >= '830101' AND c.birth_date <= '871231' AND branch_d.A3 = 'East Bohemia' AND p.type = 'OWNER'
